The app in this directory already implements the notes app. Everything it does today must keep working, with and
without JavaScript, unless this request changes it. Change the following.

## Remove German
German is hardly used, so remove it completely.
- The `Deutsch` / `English` control is removed from `/login` and the list page.

import { contract, ui } from '@hozu/core'
import { accountDelete, login } from '../../routes.ts'
import { accountMachine, DeleteAccount, deleteAccount, me, SignIn, SignOut, signIn, signOut } from './model.ts'

export const accountText = ui.messages('en', {
  en: { signIn: 'Sign in', name: 'Name', signedInAs: 'Signed in as {name}', signedOut: 'Signed out', signOut: 'Sign out', deleted: 'Account deleted' },
  de: { signIn: 'Anmelden', name: 'Name', signedInAs: 'Angemeldet als {name}', signedOut: 'Abgemeldet', signOut: 'Abmelden', deleted: 'Konto gelöscht' },
})

export const Login = ui.view({
  machine: accountMachine,
  route: login,
  render: ({ ctx, search, locale }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-sm space-y-6 px-4 py-16' }, [
      ui.a({ href: locale === 'en' ? ui.alternate('de') : ui.alternate('en'), class: 'text-sm underline' }, [locale === 'en' ? 'Deutsch' : 'English']),
      ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, [accountText.signIn]),
      search.deleted && ui.p({ role: 'status', class: 'rounded bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-emerald-800' }, [accountText.deleted]),
      ui.form({ class: 'space-y-3', on: { submit: ui.send(SignIn, { name: ui.dom.form('name') }) } }, [
        ui.label({ for: 'name', class: 'block text-sm font-medium' }, [accountText.name]),
        ui.input({
          id: 'name',
          name: 'name',
          required: true,
          minlength: 2,
          maxlength: 20,
          autocomplete: 'username',
          'aria-invalid': ctx.fields.name !== null,
          'aria-describedby': 'name-error',
          class: 'w-full rounded border px-3 py-2',
        }),
        ui.p({ id: 'name-error', class: 'text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.fields.name]),
        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'w-full rounded bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-white' }, [accountText.signIn]),
      ]),
      ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert', class: 'text-rose-600' }, [ctx.error]),
    ]),
})

export const AccountBar = ui.view({
  machine: accountMachine,
  render: () =>
    ui.header({ class: 'mx-auto flex max-w-xl items-center justify-between px-4 pt-8 text-sm text-slate-600' }, [
      ui.query(
        me,
        {},
        {
          ready: (user) => ui.p({}, [accountText.signedInAs({ name: user.name })]),
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => ui.p({}, [accountText.signedOut]), Unexpected: () => ui.p({}, ['']) },
        },
      ),
      ui.form({ on: { submit: ui.send(SignOut, {}) } }, [
        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'underline' }, [accountText.signOut]),
      ]),
    ]),
})

export const DeleteAccountPage = ui.view({
  machine: accountMachine,
  route: accountDelete,
  render: ({ ctx, when }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, ['Delete account']),
      ui.p({ class: 'text-slate-600' }, ['This deletes all of your notes, archived ones included, and signs you out.']),
      ui.form({ on: { submit: ui.send(DeleteAccount, {}) } }, [
        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded bg-rose-600 px-4 py-2 text-white' }, ['Delete my account and notes']),
      ]),
      when(['deleting'], [ui.p({ 'aria-busy': 'true' }, ['Deleting…'])]),
      ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert', class: 'text-rose-600' }, [ctx.error]),
    ]),
})

export const deletesAccount = contract(accountMachine, {
  given: { state: 'idle' },
  when: [
    { send: DeleteAccount, payload: {} },
    { done: deleteAccount, result: {} },
  ],
  expect: { state: 'idle', effects: [{ effect: deleteAccount, input: {} }, { navigate: '/login?deleted=true' }] },
})

export const signsIn = contract(accountMachine, {
  given: { state: 'idle' },
  when: [
    { send: SignIn, payload: { name: 'ada' } },
    { done: signIn, result: {} },
  ],
  expect: {
    state: 'idle',
    changes: { draft: 'ada' },
    effects: [{ effect: signIn, input: { name: 'ada' } }, { navigate: '/notes' }],
  },
})

export const signsOut = contract(accountMachine, {
  given: { state: 'idle' },
  when: [
    { send: SignOut, payload: {} },
    { done: signOut, result: {} },
  ],
  expect: { state: 'idle', effects: [{ effect: signOut, input: {} }, { navigate: '/login' }] },
})

import { project, ui } from '@hozu/core'
import { zodAdapter } from '@hozu/schema-zod'
import { accountDelete, admin, archive, home, login, notePage } from './routes.ts'
import { AdminBoard, AdminLink } from './features/admin/views.ts'
import { listUsers } from './features/admin/model.ts'
import { adminFeature } from './features/admin/feature.ts'
import { ArchiveBoard, NotesBoard, NoteView, notesText } from './features/notes/views.ts'
import { notes } from './features/notes/feature.ts'
import { getNote } from './features/notes/model.ts'
import { me, Session } from './features/account/model.ts'
import { AccountBar, accountText, DeleteAccountPage, Login } from './features/account/views.ts'
import { account } from './features/account/feature.ts'

export default project({
  schema: zodAdapter,
  session: Session,
  styles: new URL('./app.css', import.meta.url),
  app: new URL('./app.ts', import.meta.url),
  env: { files: ['.env', '.env.local'] },
  site: { url: 'http://localhost:3000', name: 'app', lang: 'en', locales: ['en', 'de'] },
  routes: { home, login, archive, admin, accountDelete, notePage },
  pages: [
    ui.page(login, { views: [Login], head: { render: () => ({ title: accountText.signIn }) } }),
    ui.page(home, {
      views: [AccountBar, AdminLink, NotesBoard],
      head: {
        query: me,
        input: () => ({}),
        render: () => ({ title: notesText.notes, noindex: true }),
        failed: { Unauthorized: login },
      },
    }),
    ui.page(archive, {
      views: [AccountBar, ArchiveBoard],
      head: {
        query: me,
        input: () => ({}),
        render: () => ({ title: 'Archive', noindex: true }),
        failed: { Unauthorized: login },
      },
    }),
    ui.page(notePage, {
      views: [NoteView],
      head: {
        query: getNote,
        input: (params) => ({ number: params.number }),
        render: (note) => ({ title: note.title, noindex: true }),
        failed: { Forbidden: login, NotFound: 404 },
      },
    }),
    ui.page(accountDelete, {
      views: [DeleteAccountPage],
      head: {
        query: me,
        input: () => ({}),
        render: () => ({ title: 'Delete account', noindex: true }),
        failed: { Unauthorized: login },
      },
    }),
    ui.page(admin, {
      views: [AccountBar, AdminBoard],
      head: {
        query: listUsers,
        input: () => ({}),
        render: () => ({ title: 'Admin', noindex: true }),
        failed: { Unauthorized: login, NotAdmin: 403 },
      },
    })],
  features: [account, notes, adminFeature],
})

content.text:
德文已全部移除，網站現在只有英文。`npx hozu check` 通過：0 個錯誤，6 個警告，6/6 個 contract 通過，lock 不需更新。

**這次的修改**

| 檔案 | 修改內容 |
|---|---|
| `hozu.config.ts` | 刪掉 `locales: ['en', 'de']`，網站只剩 `lang: 'en'` |
| `features/account/views.ts` | 刪掉 `/login` 的 `Deutsch` / `English` 連結和德文文字；`accountText` 改成一般的英文常數 |
| `features/notes/views.ts` | 刪掉列表頁的語言切換連結和德文文字；`notesText` 改成英文常數；重複標題的提示直接顯示英文 |

**驗證結果**

- **登入和新增筆記**：用 `npx hozu browse` 帶 `Accept-Language: de` 測試，開 JS 和關 JS 都正常。依序登入、新增 `Milk`、再新增一次 `Milk`，最後一步正確顯示「You already have a note with this title」，沒有錯誤。
- **語言**：`/login` 帶 `Accept-Language: de` 時，回應仍是 `<html lang="en">`。
- **啟動**：`PORT=4814 npm start` 一個指令就能在 4814 埠啟動並正常回應。測完已用 PID 停掉，埠已釋放。

**需要注意**

- 以前的 `/de/...` 網址現在回 404。德文是整個移除的，所以這是預期結果；如果有人存了這類書籤，會打不開。
- 6 個警告在這次修改之前就有，跟這次無關。其中 4 個 HZ090 是因為 `listNotes`、`listArchived`、`listShared`、`lastDeleted` 這些個人資料查詢設成 `access: 'anyone'`，沒登入也能讀。

**下一步建議**

1. 如果擔心 `/de/...` 舊連結失效，可以在 `http.redirects` 加 308 轉址到英文版網址。
2. 另外處理那 4 個 HZ090 警告，改成 `access: 'signedIn'`，避免沒登入的訪客讀到個人資料。
3. 確認後提交成 `step 28` commit（這次還沒提交）。
